concept: Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries
summary: Source-anchored research for Query-settings representative-query backfill and FCV boundaries. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: When setQuerySettings receives a query-shape hash string, representativeQuery is initially absent from $querySettings output; inspection and migration must accommodate entries without that field. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Backfill is asynchronous and best effort. The first matching execution need not populate representativeQuery; if backfill does not complete, a later matching execution triggers another attempt. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

In the inspected master implementation, settings lookup schedules backfill when BackfillCoordinator::shouldBackfill permits it, then returns the query settings. Representative-query upserts use a separate collection and catch DBException failures. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27)

Percona ClusterSync documentation requires manual query-settings migration after replication finalization. It directs users to identify exported settings by representativeQuery when present and queryShapeHash otherwise. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-20)

MongoDB 8.3 expands representative-query storage beyond the original 16 MB BSON document limit; this statement concerns representative-query storage capacity, not a general increase to BSON document limits. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
Downgrading to a version without expanded representative-query capacity restores the 16 MB limit and can lose some representative queries. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Automatic representative-query backfill starts in MongoDB 8.3 and requires FCV 8.3 or later; a matching query execution schedules the work without user action. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The inspected MongoDB master interface exposes dedicated representative-query collection creation and upsert methods. Its downgradeQuerySettings contract derives migrations from feature flags enabled at targetFCV; this development-branch interface alone does not establish released-version behavior. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27)

SERVER-129203 describes representativeQuery being stored separately in config.queryShapeRepresentativeQueries under featureFlagPQSBackfill, with insert replies including it and update replies omitting it. The issue was resolved Won't Fix with no fix version; its desired consistent reply is not evidence of shipped behavior. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-08)
